metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: IPOPOV crystallizes in the orthorhombic crystal system with space group I m m m. Reported CIF formula moiety: C36 H234 Eu36 Ni12 O174 18+,7(N1 O3 1-),11(Cl1 1-),36(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Eu1 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu2 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu3 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu4 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu5 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu6 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu7 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu8 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Ni1 (Ni) has 6 O neighbors; Ni2 (Ni) has 6 O neighbors; Eu1A (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu2A (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu3A (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu4A (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu6A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu7A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu8A (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Ni1A (Ni) has 6 O neighbors; Ni2A (Ni) has 6 O neighbors; Eu1B (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu2B (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu3B (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu4B (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu5B (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu6B (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu8B (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Ni1B (Ni) has 6 O neighbors; Ni2B (Ni) has 6 O neighbors; Eu1C (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu2C (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu3C (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu4C (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu6C (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu8C (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Ni1C (Ni) has 6 O neighbors; Ni2C (Ni) has 6 O neighbors; Eu2H (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu4H (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Ni1H (Ni) has 6 O neighbors; Eu2I (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu4I (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Ni1I (Ni) has 6 O neighbors; Eu2J (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu4J (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Ni1J (Ni) has 6 O neighbors; Eu2K (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu4K (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Ni1K (Ni) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 144 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.434-5.418 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 88.84-168.96°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C36H306Cl11N7O231Ni12Eu36.
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
